page.layout: Two printed pages side by side, each with one column of index lines. Left page: one column of 65 lines, with line numbers 10 to 60 in its right margin. Right page: one column of 65 lines, with no line numbers. Signature "I 4" at the foot of the right page. The left page has no printed page number. The running head "IOA" appears on both pages.

page.notes: Left page: the line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60 stand in the right margin and are marked as notes. Lines of the right page have no marginal text. Doubtful readings: "doc[?]ina" (line 14), "eafdem[?]" (right page line 1), "ƈti" printed for "Sancti", "veræ|vi" with a printed bar kept, "pbabilia" and "prop̃" as printed. The right page's final line is cut off by the foot of the page: "illa" is taken as printed, the word may continue. The signature "I 4" is read from a small mark at the foot and is uncertain.
